contract: sort-contract-1: candidate defines sort_word(v) -> str over L,R,X (L rotates left, R rotates right, X swaps the first two entries). A state is valid iff the word has at most 1000 letters and certificates.replay_visible(v, word) equals (1..m, 0^r). within_budget iff valid and len(word) <= T_m(n) = m(m+1)/2 + (r-1)(m-2). excess = len(word) - d(v) with d(v) the exact BFS distance to the canonical root. Crash, non-str, bad letters, >1000 letters, per-state time limit (2 s) or a batch wall limit count as invalid. combined_score = within_budget/N + 0.5/(1 + mean excess over valid states) - invalid/N (middle term 0 if no valid state).
limitations: Finite frozen states only. A valid word is an upper bound on d(v) for that state; a miss, crash or timeout proves nothing, and development scores do not extend to unseen states or r.
